coverage: Root approval and explicit path ownership; original public namespaces and unlisted assets rejected; exact eleven new public files.
All 5,094 protected paths and arbitrary smaller fixtures are counted dynamically. Unowned source/MAIN mutation, including GAME_DESIGN.md, is rejected without a retention exception.
Both current Git indexes stay unchanged during operations; MAIN additionally matches its fresh captured index.
Stale root GO, snapshot, final proof/validation and reviewed dry-run identities are rejected.
Actual Git three-way fixtures preserve five captured MAIN paragraphs and historical changelog text; conflicts remain explicit.
Exact CI/runtime, edition, five compiled public hashes and expected 276 requests gate MAIN apply. All old release tags, including v0.4.8, are pinned at final verify.
Disposable Git repository with pre-existing ignored tools/__pycache__ file: it remains byte-identical and does not block ownership; unknown nonignored game/unapproved.js still blocks.
workflow: Root reviews exact paths and fills final validation/source proof hashes, then writes the approved GO.
Freeze; generate/review clean ISO-only document candidates and patch; dry-run/review zero conflicts.
After CI/public/native gates, root updates the publication object and pending docs/evidence, explicitly refreezes using the old SHA, regenerates candidate docs and dry-run.
Apply requires the same reviewed dry-run HEAD, GO, snapshot, ownership, documents and payload. Root alone invokes apply.

Root records/copies operational receipts separately and stages/commits. Final verify is read-only and requires clean tracked source, verified runtime lineage, the annotated new tag and remote heads/tags.
limits: The helper never stages, commits, deletes worktrees or modifies indexes. Only the root may execute the real mutation commands after review.
Operational receipts are excluded only at six exact central paths to avoid recursive ownership; the helper does not copy operational receipts into MAIN. Root controls that separate reviewed step.
